attributes.residual: UNCHANGED IN MECHANISM, SHARPENED IN CLASS, and the two facts a future lane needs are now separated. (1) THE SOURCE SPACE. Every source form falls into class A (244/244 parity, one differing word at +0x228: target `addi r18,r19,0`, ours a MASK-form copy `rlwinm`) or class B (243/244, ours-only NONE, the target carrying one extra semantically redundant `addi r18,r19,0`). Which class you land in is decided by whether MWCC gives the bit-insert's destination a register distinct from the loaded byte's. Eleven axes now measured dead: declared width of idx (u8/u32/int), presence or absence of the val variable, statement-split vs single-expression vs fully-inlined OR, the canonical `(x & ~M) | (b << k)` idiom, declaration placement, OR operand order, and now the `+` spelling. The retained BASELINE is a third shape not identical to either class as first described: it is 244/244 with the differing word at +0x230 (target `slwi r17,r18,3`, ours `rlwinm r17,r18,3,13,28`), i.e. the copy AND the rlwimi both match and only the shift carries the u16 read truncation. (2) THE POSTPROCESSOR SPACE, now named rather than merely refused. Class B is instruction-count-ASYMMETRIC and no stage inserts a word. Class A and the retained baseline both have parity, but the differing word is an IMMEDIATE difference in an rlwinm mask field, not a register field: `rlwinm rD,rS,3,13,28` is `((rS & 0xFFFF) << 3)` and `slwi rD,rS,3` is `(rS << 3)`, equal only because rS provably holds a 9-bit value (a byte load OR'd with one bit at position 8). Closing that word therefore requires proving a value-RANGE fact, which is a dataflow-equivalence capability and is outside every currently shipped class -- webfrank's own guards forbid immediate differences, and equivalent_copy_form refuses because `rlwinm` decodes as no sanctioned copy form. This is recorded as capability_needed so the lane that could build a range-aware redundant-mask proof can find it; it is NOT a request to ship one unilaterally (Mandatory policy: new classes go to the integrator). DO-NOT-RETRY covers all eleven axes above. The only source lever not excluded remains one that lengthens the loaded byte's live range across the insert so MWCC must allocate a distinct destination, and no natural form in this loop does that -- the byte is dead immediately after the insert in BOTH streams (target redefines r19 at +0x234).
